data.name: Ahmadiyya
data.gender_notes: Ahmadiyya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ahmadiyya is a term of endearment for the followers of the Ahmadiyya Muslim Community, a movement that emphasizes the importance of following the Prophet Muhammad's teachings. The name Ahmadiyya carries the meaning “Lover of the Prophet Muhammad” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahmadiyya usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of the prophet muhammad and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Those who follow the Ahmadiyya path are guided by the will of Allah and strive to emulate the Prophet's example.
data.etymology: Ahmadiyya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of the Prophet Muhammad.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahmadiyya total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أحمدية
in_arabic.meaning: منسوبة إلى أحمد، المديح، الشكر، الحمد
in_arabic.long_meaning: أحمدية هي اسم مشتق من أحمد، وهو اسم من أسماء النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، ويعني المديح، الشكر، الحمد. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الأحيان للإشارة إلى جماعة أو فرقة دينية معينة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: احمدیہ
in_urdu.meaning: احمد سے منسوب، مدیحہ، شکریہ، حمد
in_urdu.long_meaning: احمدیہ ایک نام ہے جو احمد سے ماخوذ ہے، جو نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے مدیحہ، شکریہ، حمد۔ یہ نام بعض اوقات ایک خاص فرقے یا جماعت کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اسلامی تعلیمات پر یقین رکھتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अहमदीया
in_hindi.meaning: अहमद से संबंधित, प्रशंसा, धन्यवाद, स्तुति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अहमदीया एक नाम है जो अहमद से लिया गया है, जो पैगंबर मुहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम के नामों में से एक है। इसका अर्थ है प्रशंसा, धन्यवाद, स्तुति। यह नाम कभी-कभी एक विशेष समूह या समुदाय के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो इस्लामी शिक्षाओं का पालन करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: احمديہ
in_pashto.meaning: د احمد څخه اخستل شوی، ستايه، شکر، حمد
in_pashto.long_meaning: احمديہ د احمد څخه اخستل شوی نوم دی، چې د نبي محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم د نومو څخه يو دي. دغه نوم د ستايه، شکر، حمد معنی لري. دا نوم کله کله د يو خاص ډلګۍ يا ټولنې لپاره کارول کېږي چې د اسلامي تعليماتو پيروي کوي.

in_english.name: Ahmadiyya
in_english.meaning: Derived from Ahmad, meaning praise, thanksgiving, or commendation
in_english.long_meaning: Ahmadiyya is a name derived from Ahmad, one of the names of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). It signifies praise, thanksgiving, or commendation. This name is sometimes used to refer to a particular group or community that adheres to Islamic teachings, emphasizing the values of admiration and gratitude.

data.cultural_impact: The Ahmadiyya Muslim Community, founded in 1889 in India, is a dynamic and vibrant Muslim movement that has significantly contributed to interfaith dialogue and mutual understanding. The name Ahmadiyya reflects this community's devotion to the Prophet Muhammad, signifying their belief in the prophethood of Mirza Ghulam Ahmad, who is considered the reformer and reviver of Islam in the modern age.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Ahmadiyya has deep roots in the Islamic tradition. The name originates from the Arabic word "Ahmad," which means "the most praiseworthy one" or "the most loving one." For the Ahmadi Muslims, this name represents their profound devotion to Prophet Muhammad, who is regarded as the last prophet and the perfect model of conduct for Muslims. By adhering to the teachings of the Ahmadiyya movement, followers seek to attain nearness to God Almighty and strive to emulate the Prophet Muhammad's exemplary character to live a purposeful and virtuous life.
